basics.name: Rosmar Alejandra Mendoza Canchica
basics.label: Software Developer (Backend & AI) | Technical Project Manager
basics.summary: Backend Developer focused on designing and optimizing high-traffic microservices and RESTful APIs in Golang, Python, and Java. Experienced in high-scale environments like MercadoLibre and the Fintech sector, combining engineering best practices, relational databases, and AI-driven tools (Cursor, Claude) to build clean, efficient, and maintainable software.

work.name: MercadoLibre
work.summary: Development, feature expansion, and maintenance of critical microservices in Golang and high-performance RESTful APIs at massive scale.
highlights: Intensive Go Training: Selected for MercadoLibre's Golang Backend Bootcamp, mastering distributed microservices architecture, engineering best practices, and large-scale standards.
High-Impact Backend Engineering: Designed and built core Golang microservices (supported by Java and Python), maintaining 99%+ availability SLAs for platforms serving millions of users.
AI-Assisted Workflow: Integrated tools like Cursor and Claude into daily workflows to speed up endpoint development, refactor legacy code, and boost test coverage.
System Reliability & On-Call Shifts: Actively participated in rotation shifts (on-call) and live monitoring to quickly diagnose and resolve production incidents.

work.name: Mo Technologies
work.summary: Building and integrating backend services for credit and financial technology products.
highlights: Credit Services Development: Built and maintained RESTful APIs using FastAPI and Django focused on evaluating and processing financial products.
Relational Database Optimization: Designed relational data models and tuned SQL queries in PostgreSQL to enhance API response times.
Cloud Integrations & Webhooks: Connected backend services with AWS cloud infrastructure and built Webhook listeners for real-time data processing.

work.name: Mo Technologies
work.summary: Level 2 technical support and production incident resolution.
highlights: Incident Resolution: Handled and resolved Level 2 technical tickets via Jira Service Desk, strictly adhering to SLA response times.
Technical Debugging: Conducted direct code debugging in Django services and executed query analysis in PostgreSQL to resolve live production issues.

work.summary: Access management, identity security, and operational reporting dashboards.
highlights: Identity & Access Control: Managed corporate user permissions and identities integrating Active Directory and Microsoft Office 365.
Dashboards & Reporting: Designed interactive Power BI dashboards to track, audit, and report system access metrics.
.NET App Support: Assisted with permission configurations and role assignments for internal .NET applications.
